openfoam_validity_note: OpenFOAM runs stopped at the 2 h wall-clock limit (inviscid t 1.0 ms, SST t 1.15 ms). The hot starting-jet front (axis T > 600 K) had reached x = 11.3 De (OpenFOAM inviscid) and 17.9 De (OpenFOAM SST). The own inviscid run was stopped at the same 1.0 ms (front 15.4 De: the starting transients differ); the own RANS runs ran 3-4 ms (front at the domain end). Code-to-code differences are meaningful upstream of about 8 De only (exit plane, Mach disk, first shock cells); OpenFOAM axis values at 10-20 De (T_axis_10De_K, T_axis_20De_K, Z_axis_20De, peak2) belong to a starting jet and are not a measure of steady-plume disagreement.
